prompt: Redraw the entire supplied color illustration in monochrome manga style. Preserve the same person's facial identity, eye shape, mouth and expression, hair arrangement, pose, hand gestures, fingers, body proportions, costume construction, jewelry and accessories. Keep the same framing, silhouette, original background and any small existing symbolic marks. Do not invent decorations, change the costume or add scenery. Preserve the garment seams and principal folds, but reinterpret shiny colored rendering as MATTE CLOTH drawn in ink. Remove small specular highlights and consolidate fragmented reflections into a few coherent shaded planes. Do not trace every highlight boundary into a new line or turn reflections into camouflage-like patterns. Keep eyes, delicate hair strands and lace clearly legible. Draw with black ink and paper white. Arrange bold connected solid-black shapes mainly in the deepest clothing folds and hair recesses, separated by flowing white shapes. Keep light-facing arms, hands, shoulders and face mostly white; do not paint broad black patches across exposed limbs. Preserve fine facial lines, eyes, fingers and delicate lace. A solid shadow directly under the jaw is allowed. Simplify shiny cloth highlights into a few long white slits in otherwise coherent black fold shapes. No gray washes, stippling, screentones, artificial edge maps or noisy texture.
